body: Arf... not ideal but I get it for backward compatibility. Let me change that.

Without it, I get this error:
```
cannot move out of `formatted_version`, a captured variable in an `Fn` closure
  --> src\modules\java.rs:42:46
42 |                         "version" => Some(Ok(formatted_version)),
   |                                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ move occurs because `formatted_version` has type `std::string::String`, which does not implement the `Copy` trait
```
Okay I changed it to a reference using `&` and it works. 👍
